labeler: drafted by an AI assistant from full trajectory digests, blind to the rule-based labels; review before treating as human gold
protocol: One root-cause category per failure (the error that, if fixed, would most plausibly flip the verdict). first_divergence_step = 0-based index of the earliest step that departs from the reference pipeline, even if that departure alone was harmless.

labels.rationale: RPL11 comes out at -1.58 instead of ~+0.36: fold change was taken against day0 (step 6), so essential-gene depletion leaks in. Keeping treat_rep2 (step 4) and raw counts (step 5) are earlier departures but do not explain the RPL11 error.
Gini computed on log2(count+1) at step 3; every value ~0.05 vs ~0.3.

Answer RIBOSOME comes from choosing the set with the largest overlap with all significant genes instead of an enrichment test. Missing FDR (step 9) and raw counts (step 6) are present but the hypergeometric test alone would still have returned MISMATCH_REPAIR.
Step 3 re-read counts.tsv without sep='\t', overwriting the good table; every later cell fails and no answer is submitted.
Same state clobber at step 6 after a clean QC phase; cascading KeyError/NameError, no submission.
Loops on statsmodels/mageck imports and undefined variables from step 1 to the 25-step limit without ever loading data.
Correlation matrix computed at step 3 shows treat_rep2 as an outlier, but step 4 keeps every replicate 'for power'.
State clobber at step 3 (re-read without tab separator); no recovery, no submission.
Correct Gini values but submitted as a bare list instead of an object keyed by sample.
Step 2 overwrote counts with a mis-parsed table; all downstream cells error; no answer.
Step 9 sets 'FDR' = raw p-value; ~210 resistance calls with precision 0.06. Everything up to the z-test matches the reference.
Replicate correlations were printed (step 6) but ignored; step 7 keeps treat_rep2.

All 10 core-essential candidates called treatment-specific on the reasoning that anything depleted under drug responds to it (step 10). Skipping normalization at step 6 is the first departure but is harmless for a z-score centred on non-targeting guides.
Right sample, wrong diagnosis: low correlation read as a sample swap while ignoring 110 reads/sgRNA and the highest Gini, which indicate a bottleneck.
Asked for guides with zero reads in EVERY sample; counted guides with a zero in ANY sample (454 vs 40). A misreading of the question rather than a QC computation error.
Clean pipeline through FDR; at step 10 every depleted gene is called treatment-specific, so all core essentials are misclassified.
Coverage divided by number of genes (step 2), inflating it 4x, so treat_rep2 is not flagged below 200x.
Step 5 clobbers the counts table; every later cell fails (it was also about to compare against day0, but never got that far).
State clobber at step 4 after QC; cascading errors, no answer.
Ranked by most negative z for a RESISTANCE question; the list is all sensitizers (PALB2, BRCA2, MGMT...). Pipeline before step 8 matches the reference.
